scope: Active predefined templates in development only; no production query or writes.
rules: Visible UUIDs/internal IDs must be removed from subjects and bodies; internal links can retain IDs.
Choose a visual family on Canvas before replacing system defaults.
Use source identity once, meaningful actual times and human-readable values; no raw created/updated event keys.
Use separate sentiment and tone only after completed authorized analysis.
Preserve manager edits, deleted defaults and saved rule snapshots.
